g.title: RaspberryPi_GPIO
g.text: Logic feed ~60-100 mA total (never connect 5V Pin 2/4 or 6V Servo V+)

g.title: Controller_Left
g.text: OE + V+ (6V) stay open on logic header

g.title: Controller_Right
g.text: OE + V+ (6V) stay open on logic header

g.title: Multiplexer
g.text: Addr 0x71 (A0 tied to 3.3V) | CH0-CH7 Data + Clock Only
No 3.3V/GND pins on CH0-CH7; CH6 (INA228 BN/YE) + CH7 (ToF) reserved

g.title: Wandler_LF
